name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for doorway modifications?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for doorway modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for interior doorway modifications, prioritize experience with accessibility projects and local building codes, especially in the Bay Area. Look for licensed and insured professionals like City Dweller, LLC who can provide references, detailed proposals, and communicate clearly. Ensure they understand your specific accessibility needs and can offer solutions that blend functionality with your home's aesthetics. Transparent pricing and a clear timeline are also crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with accessibility experience, local code knowledge, licenses, insurance, clear communication, and detailed proposals.
